meta.tagline: Football match probabilities from a statistical model, with every prediction scored in public.
meta.description: Match probabilities for 1X2, goals and both teams to score from a Dixon-Coles model. Every prediction is settled and published, wins and losses alike.

footer.dataSourceText: Fixtures, results and odds are supplied by third-party data providers and may lag live events. Probabilities come from our own statistical model.
footer.responsibleText: Predictions are probabilities, not guarantees. Nothing on this site is betting advice. If you gamble, only stake what you can afford to lose. 18+.

common.emptyLead: There is no data for this selection. Try a different date or league.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.lead: The page could not be loaded. This is usually temporary.
errors.notFoundLead: The address may be wrong or the page has moved.

home.title: Probabilities, not promises.
home.lead: A Dixon-Coles model rates every fixture in the leagues it is trained on. Each prediction is settled after the final whistle and published, whether it won or lost.

predictions.title: Predictions
predictions.lead: Match probabilities from the Dixon-Coles model for the leagues it is trained on. Figures are calibrated against past results and update overnight.
predictions.emptyLead: The model publishes predictions the night before kick-off for leagues it is trained on.
predictions.footnote: Pick = the outcome the model rates most likely; the percentage next to it is the calibrated probability, not the raw model output. Over/Under 2.5 and BTTS show the favoured side with its calibrated probability. Times are shown in your local time zone.

match.metaDescription: {home} vs {away}, {league}: model probabilities {pHome}% / {pDraw}% / {pAway}% for home, draw and away, with expected goals, likely scores and handicap lines.
match.summary: The model leans {pick} at {p}%. Expected goals: {home} {lh}, {away} {la}. Over 2.5 goals {over}%, both teams to score {btts}%.
match.summaryForm: {home} won {hw} of their last {hn}; {away} won {aw} of their last {an}.
match.noMarket: No market snapshot for this match
match.edgeNote: Edge = model probability minus the bookmaker's margin-free probability, in percentage points; positive means the model rates the outcome higher than the market.
match.calibratedGoals: Calibrated calls: {ou} · BTTS {btts}. The table above is the raw Poisson grid from the expected goals.
match.handicapNote: Whole and half lines only. The fair line is where both sides are closest to even after pushes; it is information, not a recommendation.
match.formMeta: last settled matches in our data
match.noH2h: No previous meetings in our data.
match.modelNote: The headline 1X2 figures come from the Dixon-Coles fit, which corrects low-scoring draws. The Poisson grid on this page does not apply that correction, so its 1X2 split can differ by a point or two.
match.disclaimer: Probabilities are model estimates and are not guarantees. This page is not betting advice. 18+.

results.title: Results
results.lead: Every settled match in the leagues the model covers, with the pick it made and how it landed. Nothing is removed after the fact.
results.aside: Aggregated accuracy, calibration and returns are on the
results.emptyTitle: No settled matches for this filter
results.emptyLead: Widen the period or pick another league.
results.footnote: Hit rate counts the 1X2 pick only. Over/under 2.5 and both-teams-to-score calls are settled from the final score. The percentage next to a pick is the calibrated probability at the time it was published.
results.unresolvedNote: {count, plural, =1 {# match} other {# matches}} in this filter never received a final score (postponed, abandoned or missing from the feed) and are left out of the list and the counts.

performance.title: Performance
performance.lead: The full settled record of the model in its covered leagues: hit rate, Brier score, calibration and flat-stake returns. Bad months stay on the page.
performance.emptyLead: The track record starts once the first covered matches are settled.
performance.roiNone: No odds snapshots available yet, so no return can be computed.
performance.monthlyNote: Small months swing wildly; read them with the sample size in view.
performance.calibrationMeta: calibrated confidence vs observed hit rate
performance.calibrationNote: A well-calibrated model sits on the diagonal: picks published at 60% should land about 60% of the time. Gaps beyond 10 points are marked. Bins with fewer than 10 picks are listed but not plotted.
performance.leaguesNote: Only leagues with settled matches are listed.
performance.marketsNote: Over/under 2.5 and both-teams-to-score are scored on the raw model probability and settled from the final score. Their Brier is binary (0.25 = coin flip).
performance.roiExplain: One unit on the model's 1X2 pick at the last captured odds before kick-off (closing, else opening). Only matches with an odds snapshot count, so this window is shorter than the full record. The bookmaker line shows how often the market favourite won over the same matches, with its margin-free Brier.
